market_summary.trend: BTC at ~$64,765 (-0.3% in 24h, +11% in July). Pulling back from 3-week high of $65,551 hit today. Consolidating after CPI/PPI-driven relief rally from $58K late-June low.
market_summary.sentiment: Mixed: Extreme Fear (F&G Index ~23) vs media sentiment 63/100 Greed. Price rising while Fear index stays low = contrarian bullish divergence / possible seller exhaustion.
market_summary.macro: Soft CPI (Jul 14, -0.4% MoM) and PPI (Jul 15, -0.3% MoM) delivered dovish surprise. Annual CPI 3.5%. Rate-cut expectations for H2 2026 rising. FOMC on hold at 3.50-3.75%. Warsh testimony (Jul 15) passed without hawkish shock.
market_summary.etf_flows: ETF 10-day outflow streak ended: week of July 11 saw $197M net inflows (first positive week in 8). Goldman Sachs filed for new BTC ETF. IBIT options limit raised to 1M contracts.
market_summary.technicals: Day candle: high $65,551 / low $64,432 / current $64,765. Intraday pullback from highs. Support at $64,400. Monthly trend bullish (+11%) but medium-term downtrend from Jan $93K high still structural.
market_summary.whale_activity: Whales selling into rally; retail accumulating. 326 WBTC withdrawn from Ethereum exchanges (largest net outflow since June) - accumulation signal. Mixed.
market_summary.regulatory: Japan reclassified crypto as financial assets with tax reduction. SEC neutral stance on ETFs. Taiwan lawmakers calling for national BTC reserves.
